techStack: TypeScript ~6.0.2, ESM modules (type: module), target ES2023, moduleResolution: bundler
Express 5.2.1 — req.query is Record<string, unknown>; response via res.json()
Vitest 4.1.5 + Supertest 7.2.2 for HTTP integration tests
noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters are enabled — no dead variables allowed after changes
No external query/validation libraries — custom parsing in queryParser.ts
strict: true is NOT set, but individual checks are enabled (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch)
features: queryParser.ts defines local InternalSort type ('priceAsc' | 'priceDesc' | 'ratingDesc' | 'nameAsc' | 'nameDesc') and validates against a set of allowed camelCase values; hyphenated values are silently dropped
productService.ts returns object with 'count' and 'pages' instead of 'total' and 'totalPages'; sort comparisons use camelCase InternalSort values
Filters (search, category, inStock) are applied sequentially and are correct — must not change
Pagination math (Math.ceil(count / limit)) is correct — only the field names in the return object are wrong
Controller is a thin pass-through: parseProductQuery(req.query) → getAllProducts(query) → res.json(result); no transformation happens there
Tests assert: total (not count), totalPages (not pages), data, page, limit; sort tests use hyphenated query params (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc)
architecture: Layer order: routes → middleware (auth) → controllers → services → utils → data
InternalSort is defined locally in both queryParser.ts and productService.ts — changing it in both files is self-contained and does not require touching product.ts
types/product.ts defines PaginatedResponse<T> with 'total' and 'totalPages' — the service's return type should conform to this but currently does not
getAllProducts return type is Promise<Record<string, unknown>> — renaming fields in the returned object literal is sufficient; no function signature changes needed for tests to pass
Only two files may be modified per requirement 10: src/utils/queryParser.ts and src/services/productService.ts
No index files or re-exports exist — each file imports directly from source; no cascading changes needed
edgeCases: Unknown sort value (e.g. sort=unknown): must remain silently ignored; no sort applied — existing guard logic handles this and must be preserved
Sort param omitted: products return in default insertion order — existing fallback handles this
camelCase sort values (priceAsc, etc.): no visible tests assert they work; implementation may drop camelCase acceptance as long as hyphenated values work per requirements 1–3
totalPages when total=0: Math.ceil(0/limit)=0 — correct, no special case needed
totalPages when total is exactly divisible by limit (15/5=3): Math.ceil gives 3 — correct
total reflects filtered pre-pagination count, not original dataset size — existing count variable already captures this before the slice
InternalSort type must be consistent between queryParser.ts and productService.ts — both define it locally, both must use the same string literals so comparisons work
TypeScript must compile cleanly: after changing InternalSort values, all comparison branches in productService.ts must use the updated literals or tsc will catch the mismatch
